name: A Personal Introduction
tagline: An oversized personal letter, signed by a real person.
typography: Baskerville for the opening letter and headings, Avenir Next for practical information.
rationale: The letter makes the clinic-to-person handoff explicit. The image is a slot for his portrait, with his name and affiliation immediately alongside it.
mobile: The opening letter and orientation precede the portrait and details.
supporting: First-person biography, a practical description of sessions and a clear clinic relationship.
trust: One verified identity and one confirmed inquiry route, with no assumed independent practice.
seo: Lead with the verified name, designation and Vancouver context.
accessibility: Native disclosures, visible focus, selectable type and a linear reading order.
tradeoff: The letter depends on a short introduction that sounds like him. Commission a real portrait before launch.
